title: Pathways Linking Reduced Sleep Duration and Quality to Obesity Risk
brief_summary: This study is designed to study the pathways through which short sleep duration or poor sleep quality can lead to an increased risk of developing diabetes and obesity.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Normal weight
* Healthy
* Normal sleep times

Exclusion Criteria:

* Sleep disorders
* Overweight
* Diabetes
* Other health conditions
* Excessive caffeine and alcohol intake
* Smoking
